basic_details.job_title: WCD&SC Dept., Nalgonda Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 4 Gender Specialist, MTS and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Four outsourcing posts – District Mission Co-ordinator (1), Gender Specialist (2) and Multi Purpose Staff (MTS) (1) – are open in the District Hub for Empowerment of Women (DHEW), Nalgonda, set up under the Mission Shakti scheme. The Women, Children, Disabled and Senior Citizens Welfare Department, Nalgonda District, Government of Telangana asks candidates to submit the completed application form, with the required certificates, at the Office of the District Welfare Officer, Sankshema Bhavan, Collectorate, Nalgonda from 16 November 2026 to 21 November 2026, 5.00 PM.

age_limit.details: District Mission Coordinator: Applicant’s age must be between 21-35 years (5 years relaxation for SC/ST/BC Candidates) as on 1st July 2026. Gender Specialist: Applicant’s age must be between 21-35 years (5 years relaxation for SC/ST/BC Candidates) as on 1st July 2026. MTS: Applicant’s age must be between 21-35 years (5 years relaxation for SC/ST/BC Candidates) as on 1st July 2026.

qualification.details: All four posts are filled on an outsourcing basis. The notice itself does not print the qualification, age limit or pay for any of the posts; it states that the qualifications, the age and the application form are on the district website (https://nalgonda.telangana.gov.in). Candidates should check the official notification and the website for the post-specific eligibility of each post.

salary_details.details: District Mission Coordinator: 38500/- Gender Specialist: 25000/- MTS: 15600/-

important_instructions: The District Collector, Nalgonda has the authority to cancel this job notification without giving any reason. Copies of the notification were displayed on the notice boards of the Collectorate and the DWO Office, Nalgonda.

content_sections.heading: About DHEW Nalgonda
content_sections.text: The District Hub for Empowerment of Women (DHEW), Nalgonda has been set up under the Mission Shakti scheme in the Office of the District Welfare Officer, Women, Children, Disabled and Senior Citizens Welfare Department, Nalgonda District. The notice was issued by Smt. D. Lavanyakumari, District Welfare Officer (FAC), Nalgonda, with the approval of the District Collector, Nalgonda (note approval dated 11.11.2026), and is signed on behalf of the District Collector / Chairman, Nalgonda.

content_sections.heading: Qualification
content_sections.text: District Mission Coordinator: Qualification: Graduate preferably in Social Sciences/ Life sciences/ Nutrition/ Medicine /Health management / Social work/ Rural management. Experience: At least 3 years experience of working with the Government/Non Government organizations in related domain. Gender Specialist: Qualification: Graduate in social work/ other social disciplines. Post-graduates will be preferred. Experience: At least 3 years experience of working with the Government/Non Government organizations in gender focussed themes MTS: 10th class pass under 10+2 system from any recognised board.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: District Mission Coordinator: Applicant’s age must be between 21-35 years (5 years relaxation for SC/ST/BC Candidates) as on 1st July 2026. Gender Specialist: Applicant’s age must be between 21-35 years (5 years relaxation for SC/ST/BC Candidates) as on 1st July 2026. MTS: Applicant’s age must be between 21-35 years (5 years relaxation for SC/ST/BC Candidates) as on 1st July 2026.

content_sections.heading: Salary
content_sections.text: District Mission Coordinator: 38500/- Gender Specialist: 25000/- MTS: 15600/-

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The completed application form, with the required certificates attached, must be submitted at: Office of the District Welfare Officer, Women, Children, Disabled and Senior Citizens Welfare Department, Sankshema Bhavan, Collectorate, Nalgonda. Submission window: 16-11-2026 to 21.11.2026, up to 5.00 PM. Application forms that arrive late by post will be rejected, so a posted form must reach the office by the deadline. The application form, together with the qualifications and age details for each post, is available on the district website ( https://nalgonda.telangana.gov.in ). Office contact printed on the covering letter: email [email protected] , phone 9440814566.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All four posts are filled on an outsourcing basis. The notice itself does not print the qualification, age limit or pay for any of the posts; it states that the qualifications, the age and the application form are on the district website ( https://nalgonda.telangana.gov.in ). Candidates should check the official notification and the website for the post-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The District Collector, Nalgonda has the authority to cancel this job notification without giving any reason. Copies of the notification were displayed on the notice boards of the Collectorate and the DWO Office, Nalgonda.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in DHEW Nalgonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 outsourcing posts: District Mission Co-ordinator (1), Gender Specialist (2) and Multi Purpose Staff (MTS) (1).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for DHEW Nalgonda Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted by 21 November 2026, 5.00 PM; forms that arrive late by post will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. From when can applications be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications can be submitted from 16 November 2026 to 21 November 2026, 5.00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for DHEW Nalgonda posts?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form, attach the required certificates and submit it at the Office of the District Welfare Officer, WCD&SC Department, Sankshema Bhavan, Collectorate, Nalgonda.

faq.question: Q5. Where can I get the application form and qualification details?
faq.answer: The notice says the qualifications, age details and application form are on the district website, https://nalgonda.telangana.gov.in.

faq.question: Q6. Are these permanent posts?
faq.answer: No, the notice says all four posts are to be filled on an outsourcing basis in the District Hub for Empowerment of Women, Nalgonda.

faq.question: Q7. Under which scheme are these posts?
faq.answer: The posts are in the District Hub for Empowerment of Women (DHEW), Nalgonda, set up under the Mission Shakti scheme.

faq.question: Q8. Can the notification be cancelled?
faq.answer: Yes, the District Collector, Nalgonda has the authority to cancel this notification without giving any reason.
